## About Me

I am a marketing student focused on learning how brands connect with consumers through strategy, research, content, and data. My coursework and projects have helped me build experience in campaign planning, consumer insights, marketing analytics, and professional presentation design.

My goal is to pursue opportunities in marketing, especially in sports marketing, brand strategy, and data-driven marketing roles. I am continuing to build my technical and creative skills through portfolio projects, analytics work, and real-world marketing experience.
